name: Old Bridge Area of the Old City of Mostar
description: In the Neretva River valley of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Mostar's Old Town grew around Stari Most, a single stone arch that rises high above the water. It was designed by the Ottoman architect Sinan. Destroyed in the 1990s conflict, the bridge and the surrounding lanes of Ottoman-era houses were carefully rebuilt, and the town now stands as a symbol of reconciliation between communities.
